# Vendored for the izakaya page

- `DRACOLoader.js`: three.js r170 (`examples/jsm/loaders/DRACOLoader.js`, MIT, `LICENSE-THREE.txt`), its import of
  `three` pointed at the site's own copy (`/johansson-town/vendor/three.module.js`, also r170).
- `draco/draco_decoder.wasm`, `draco/draco_wasm_wrapper.js`: Google's Draco decoder as three.js r170 ships it
  (`examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf/`, Apache License 2.0).

Fetched from the npm registry (`three-0.170.0.tgz`) on 29 October 2026.
